name: venture-atlas-os
description: Static evidence-aware venture idea research repository and GitHub Pages site

scripts.validate:source: npm run validate:data && npm run validate:links
scripts.validate:data: node scripts/validate-data.js --strict --check && python scripts/validate-schema.py && python scripts/build-research-proposal-catalog.py && node scripts/validate-authority-registries.js && node scripts/validate-lifecycle-receipts.js && node scripts/validate-shockgraph.js && node scripts/validate-phaseshift.js && node scripts/build-phase-forward-counterfactuals.js && node scripts/validate-validation-funnel.js && node scripts/validate-capital-clock.js && node scripts/validate-capital-clock-ledger.js
scripts.generate: npm run generate:search && npm run generate:status
scripts.build: npm run generate && npm run build:site
scripts.build:verified: npm run clean && npm run generate && npm run build:site && npm run validate:public && npm run test:pwa
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:race && npm run test:integration
scripts.quality:source: npm run check-js && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run test:python && npm run validate:source && npm run validate:completion && node scripts/build-repository-meta.js && node scripts/build-repository-meta.js --check && npm run check-consistency && npm run check-task-graph && npm run check:drift && python scripts/verify_constitution.py && python scripts/check_privacy.py
scripts.quality: npm run quality:source && npm run build:verified
scripts.ci: npm run clean && npm run typecheck && npm run validate:source && npm run test:unit && npm run build && npm run validate:public
scripts.ci:full: npm run quality && npm run test:race && npm run test:providers && npm run test:e2e
scripts.check-js: node --check assets/js/site.js && node --check assets/js/home.js && node --check assets/js/research-catalog.js
